$comment: Slots of sections/closing.ts, on the T1 closing plate (1120x480 at 1440). h2a + h2b: the two-line serif H2 (48px; 34px at 390), centred, <= 30 characters together; each line one line at 1440 up to 20 characters. Then the setup-prompt card in its glass bezel: legend = the card's label in the glass bar (Inter 13px, one line up to 40); prompt = the sentence the Copy button puts on the clipboard (Inter 16px; one line up to about 50 characters at 1440, two lines at 390); copy / copied = the button's two states (the button is as wide as the longer one; the live region announces copied). Then primary = the lime CTA, and caption = the one line under it (what happens when you click; one line at 1440, two at 390 when it reaches 50). X placeholders of realistic length; measurements in staging v5/sections/faq-closing/NOTES.md. Budgets: tests/home-copy-slots.test.mjs.
